measured_in: CI, run 36328815915, release-size job, first run of this gate
note: CI is where the gate runs, so CI is where the baseline was measured. CI never has app/google-services.json (gitignored, no workflow writes it), so Firebase stays compileOnly and out of the APK. Local numbers for the same tree on 2026-09-27: with that file 9998692 bytes, without it 9299727 bytes, measured A-B-A with identical repeats, so Firebase is worth +698965 (+7.5%) locally. The remaining 187596 bytes (+2.06% of this baseline) between the local build without the file and the CI build is not pinned; the local Gradle daemon runs OpenJDK 26 while CI runs Temurin 17.0.20-1. The filename is not recorded on purpose: versionName carries the git commit count, so it changes every commit.
